chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: Speed Webb broadcast locally but never recorded
summary: Speed Webb's band broadcast locally but never made records or came to New York, which is why it was not a success.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: No, it's very monotonous. Was there any... Were bands broadcasting locally, too? In other words, if you were working with Speed Webb, was there any broadcasting?
We broadcasted a few times. Sure, we did. But it wasn't on a national hookup, but around the town and

around the vicinity. But we just didn't get a chance. We didn't get a chance to make records or anything. That's why that band wasn't a success. We didn't make records. And we didn't come to New York.
